summary: This is an 8-K filed by Keel Infrastructure Corp. announcing its intent to offer $350M aggregate principal amount of convertible senior notes due 2032, with an option for initial purchasers to buy up to an additional $58M. The notes are senior unsecured obligations guaranteed by subsidiary Bitfarms Ltd., convertible into cash and/or common stock under certain conditions. Terms such as conversion price, interest rate, and premium are not disclosed. The offering is subject to market conditions with no assurance of completion. This is a routine capital markets transaction—a convertible note offering—not a special situation event.
